---
title: "Wellbeing report"
format: html
params:
  faculty: "Education"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(dplyr)

students  <- read.csv("students.csv")
semesters <- read.csv("semesters.csv")

faculty_semesters <- semesters |>
  left_join(students, join_by(student_id)) |>
  filter(faculty == params$faculty)
```

This report describes the `r n_distinct(faculty_semesters$student_id)` students
of the Faculty of `r params$faculty`.

```{r}
faculty_semesters |>
  summarise(Students = n_distinct(student_id),
            Wellbeing = mean(wellbeing, na.rm = TRUE),
            .by = semester) |>
  knitr::kable(digits = 1, col.names = c("Semester", "Students", "Average wellbeing"))
```
